newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary shares register highest daily turnover.
newsitem.headline: Hungary shares register highest daily turnover.

text.p: The Budapest Stock Exchange (BSE) registered its highest daily spot share turnover of 9.177 billion forints on Wednesday.
The previous highest turnover of 5.77 billion forints was reached in August 1995.
According to the BSE's official closing data, the BUX index closed at 5,985.17 points, up 32.25, unchanged from the preliminary figure.
Three stocks generated the bulk of turnover, with pharmaceuticals Richter accounting for 3.29 billion forints, oil company MOL for 2.56 billion forints and chemicals TVK for 1.76 billion.
Due to May Day public holidays the next market day in Hungary will be Monday, May 5.
